Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

1. In @finance/billing/subscription_worker.py, analyze subscription processing logic and verify that recurring monthly and annual invoice collections handle 50,000 enterprise accounts.
2. In @database/schema/invoices.sql, inspect table schemas and ensure that invoice records include immutable audit history with unique constraint enforcement on Stripe charge identifiers.

16. The Vice President of Finance requires full balance-sheet reconciliations demonstrating zero ledger variance across all active enterprise accounts before approving production deployment.
17. In @gateway_router.py, verify that payment routing rules select lowest-cost payment gateways based on card currency and geographic issuing region.
18. In @dunning_manager.py, verify that dunning notification managers schedule automated email notifications on day 1, day 3, day 7, and day 14 of payment delinquencies.
19. In @dispute_handler.py, verify that dispute management workers ingest chargeback webhook events and freeze affected account subscription entitlements immediately.
20. In @report_exporter.py, verify that financial reporting exporters generate GAAP-compliant revenue recognition schedules amortizing annual upfront contract payments monthly.
21. In @audit_hasher.py, verify that audit trail hashing computes SHA-256 cryptographic hashes of every invoice transition, storing hash chains in immutable audit logs.
22. In @fraud_client.py, verify that fraud scoring integrations screen initial subscription checkouts, blocking transactions with risk scores above 75.
23. The enterprise risk committee mandates quarterly external penetration tests verifying zero payment card data exposures across all billing microservices.
24. In @reconciliation_worker.py, verify that automated invoice reconciliation workers match bank settlement statement records against internal ledger invoices within 2 hours.
25. In @pricing_engine.py, verify that tiered pricing calculation engines calculate graduated volume discounts based on monthly active user metrics.
26. In @credit_manager.py, verify that credit note generation services generate credit adjustments for prorated subscription cancellations.
27. In @entity_manager.py, verify that multi-entity accounting partitions financial transactions by legal operating subsidiary and tax jurisdiction.
28. In @dunning_analytics.py, verify that automated dunning analytics export recovery rate metrics to Metabase dashboards weekly.
29. The compliance officer mandates annual third-party SOC 1 Type II examinations across all automated billing systems.
30. In @dunning_scheduler.py, verify that dunning retry schedules notify customer account managers on day 21 before service deactivation.
31. In @gateway_failover.py, verify that payment gateway failover routes failed transactions to secondary processors automatically.
32. In @currency_reconciler.py, verify that multi-currency billing reconciliation verifies exchange rate conversions across 30 foreign currencies against daily treasury fixings.
33. In @dispute_tracker.py, verify that invoice payment dispute tracking emits webhook events to enterprise resource planning systems when chargebacks occur.
34. In @credit_ledger.py, verify that customer credit balance ledgers track prepaid account credits, deducting balances automatically on invoice finalization.
35. In @event_auditor.py, verify that billing event stream auditing verifies that payment lifecycle events are emitted in strict chronological order.
36. In @jurisdiction_map.py, verify that tax jurisdiction mapping tables maintain up-to-date postal code mappings for regional sales taxes.

38. Site reliability engineers must monitor billing worker queue depth alerting on backlogs."}]
